# Board

For the person who starts longer tasks, checks in a few times a day, and owns the review.

Each agent session is a card that moves from **Doing** to **Review** to **Done**. A card moves on
its own only when its status is certain: working is Doing, needing you is Needs you, finishing
while you watch is Review, exiting is Done. Everything else is your call, and it stays put until
the agent starts working again, which moves the card back with a note saying why. Done is never
guessed: Hivemind cannot know a change was merged, so the board does not pretend to.

It asks for nothing beyond showing your workspace: it cannot start, close or message agents.
